correctness.rationale: The graph target is Cartesian K3□K3, not tensor product; a cell is five nonempty masks with complete-bipartite adjacency at each consecutive source edge and dimension Σ(|A_i|-1). Independently enumerated ALL valid singleton 5-tuples (900), completed all cells by valid coordinate supersets (4,680 cells with f=(900,2160,1440,180)). An independent maximal-free-face collapse reconstruction removes exactly 180 (3,2) and 180 (2,1) pairs, ending with 4 connected 2-dimensional components each (225 vertices,495 edges,270 faces); each surviving edge belongs to precisely 2 faces, each of 900 vertex links is a single cycle (degree histogram 600/240/60 at 4/5/6), and orientability propagates coherently across all 1,080 surviving faces. Euler characteristic per component 225-495+270=0; the classification of closed orientable surfaces gives torus. Inspected actual verify.py and certificate.json including signed boundary-squared check and exact collapse algorithm; independent code reproduced all key counts. This is a COMPLETE finite enumeration of the specified object, not an extrapolation to larger graphs.
